name: Jameson Blake
bio:
Jameson Blake's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts and building model racing cars. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, quickly finding his niche in aerodynamics. His career took off at a small IndyCar team, where he proved his ability to optimize car performance with limited resources. He then moved to GT racing, drawn by the technical challenges of balancing performance and reliability. 

Jameson is known for his meticulous attention to detail and data-driven approach. He believes in empowering his team, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. His focus is on finding marginal gains through rigorous analysis and creative problem-solving. He joined Iron Dames to bring his experience and technical acumen to a team pushing the boundaries of female representation in motorsport.

What sets Jameson apart is his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into practical solutions, ensuring that every team member understands the 'why' behind each adjustment. He's not just a technical director; he's a teacher and a mentor, dedicated to cultivating the next generation of motorsport engineers.
